'''Plex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transport]], the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
